title: Initial configuration predicate
statement: Given an oracle $\mathrm{orc}:\mathrm{Fin}(4)\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})\to\mathrm{Bool}$, a Boolean input list $x$, and natural numbers $r,u$, define the initial predicate to be the oracle's answer at index $1$ on the encoding of $x$ together with the binary representations of $u$ and $r$, nested in that order.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle from indices in $\mathrm{Fin}(4)$ and Boolean lists to Boolean answers
